assembly_design: Assemble on the bench with every power source disconnected and the PETG parts removed from the heating area. Slide both inner sleeves and the outer sleeve onto wires before soldering.

XP01 and XP02 remain selected0.5mm2 wire, nominal insulation OD1.8mm. Each smooth solder joint must fit the design OD<=2.2mm without cutting strands. If not, revise this replaceable pigtail and its sleeve selection; never force the sleeve.

Insulate the two joints separately. The20mm inner and50mm outer cuts are preparation allowances, not verified finished lengths. After shrinking require >=5mm overlap on wire insulation and >=5mm outer overlap over inner sleeves, with no exposed conductive path.
Heat-shrink outside the robot. TE specifies95C minimum shrink and121C recovery. These are sleeve data, not a hot-air gun setting, a PETG rating or an approved fuse solder profile.

Reserve two dedicated ties for the sleeved body and two separate restraints on insulated conductors. Keep tie locks outside4x2 slots. Do not bend fuse leads to hold wire load or treat a heat-shrink sleeve as an independent strain relief.

Do not install this assembly inside the old10mm-long nominal fuse box: that box represented the body only. Route the complete sleeved pigtail, joints, tie locks and XP01 before declaring mountability. XP01<=50mm includes the unfused fuse lead and all bends; no30mm service allowance before fuse.
source_limitations: TE product pages and current manufacturer drawing were read through web retrieval; PDF visual extraction was not available. Use the broader webpage wall0.5+/-0.2mm for conservative planning, not a guessed thinner catalogue value.

Direct local manufacturer downloads returned Access Denied. Mouser URLs returned an HTML denial which PyMuPDF rendered; those files are named access-denied and are NOT datasheets or dimensional evidence.
